blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `cancelClaimValidateOrderStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a confirmed claim can be canceled. If the claim is canceled,
or the claim's fulfillments are not canceled, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order claim's details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

children.name: CancelClaimValidateOrderStepInput
children.description: The data to validate the cancelation of a confirmed order claim.
